title: ExtensionDisposer
description: Undoes one Extension.install call, for the one Application that call was made against. Returned by `install`, held by that Application, and invoked exactly once during its teardown. Must be synchronous - Application.destroy does not await it. Work that genuinely cannot finish synchronously belongs behind an AbortSignal the extension owns, aborted from here.
